messages:
anika: heads-up — the new HF model we converted is passing unit tests but failing evals after quant + reload. periodic token drift in long-chat benchmarks.

devon: can you paste the config.json we used? sounds like kv/head mismatch or max_pos cutover.

anika: yep. snippet from the converted config (from hf->redwood tool):
```json
{
  "rope_scaling": {"factor": 0.8},
  "sliding_window": 128,
  "num_key_value_heads": 4,
  "max_position_embeddings": 1024
}
```

anika: model's original HF config had `num_key_value_heads: 8` and `sliding_window: null` (uses global kv cache). converter set a sliding_window and halved kv heads.

matt: that would change KV tensor shape. if we map heads->kv_heads wrong you get attention reading the wrong offsets, which shows up as periodic repeats in long sequences.

irene: do we have the failing eval sample? quick diff of logits?

anika: attaching short failure excerpt:
```
-- REF: ...the committee agreed to postpone the vote until next quarter...
-- GOT: ...the committee agreed to postpone the vote until next quorum...
(repeats every ~128 tokens)
```

devon: repeating every ~128 tokens matches `sliding_window: 128` boundary. converter probably split kv cache stride and reshaped [batch, heads, seq, head_dim] -> [batch, kv_heads, ...] incorrectly.

matt: quick triage steps:
1) confirm HF config `num_key_value_heads` (original model)
2) compare converter mapping rules in `hf_to_redwood/config_map.py` for `sliding_window` and `kv` fields
3) run small repro: export weights, reshape kv with both 8 and 4 heads and run single-step attention check

anika: I ran 1 & 3. original HF has `num_key_value_heads: 8`. when I forced converter to keep 8, eval artifacts disappear. when left as 4, artifacts present.

irene: ok blockers: this conversion change slipped past smoke tests because short-context unit tests don't hit sliding window boundaries. we need a regression test for periodic artifacts + a config-compat guard.

devon: for immediate mitigation, ops-bot can we hold this model from canary? tag: @ops-bot please add `hold` to model registry for model-id `redwood-onboard/izelda-v1` pending config fix.

ops-bot: noted. Model redwood-onboard/izelda-v1 set to HOLD by request of devon at 1728505600.

matt: long-term: update converter to prefer preserving `num_key_value_heads` if present in HF config. if HF omits it, infer from `hidden_size / num_attention_heads` as fallback. also, avoid setting `sliding_window` implicitly unless HF used sliding attention implementation.

anika: filing a PR description: "preserve HF num_key_value_heads and don't set sliding_window unless explicit; add sliding-window boundary unit test". will link PR in thread when ready.

devon: also flag quant pipeline: quant+reload might hide shape mismatch until eval. add a quick KV-shape parity check after quantization step (compare param.count and reshape sums).

irene: add to config-compatibility checklist: rope_scaling mismatch (factor vs pair), sliding_window defaulting, num_key_value_heads inference, and max_position_embeddings truncation. these have caused at least 3 onboarding regressions last quarter.

anika: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/pull/3142 — includes test vectors and a small repro script. assigning to @matt for review.

matt: reviewing now. will also add a short ephemeral check in the conversion CLI to warn when `sliding_window` is set but `num_key_value_heads` changed.

irene: thanks all. once PR merges, re-run the full canary with quant and long-chat evals. ping me when done and I'll lift the hold. :thumbsup:
